comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
For those who still wonder what this skill exactly does:

It increases your loading speed and the higher rank the faster your munitions are loaded.

"Less prone to failure" means that the cannons will fail lesser when trying to shoot. In otherwords it prolongs the lifespan for the cannons that you're using for sea battles(less durability loss) and higher rank is higher lifespan.

So for those who're doing sea battle a lot THIS SKILL is essential!
